citations.text: See Brown v. United States, 942 F. 3d 1069, 1075 (2019) (per curiam ).
Compare Winarske v. United States, 913 F. 3d 765 (CA8 2019);
Gallagher v. United States, 711 F. 3d 315 (CA2 2013) (per curiam );
and Brannigan v. United States, 249 F. 3d 584 (CA7 2001),
and Williams v. United States, 927 F. 3d 427 (CA6 2019).
See Hawaii v. Office of Hawaiian Affairs, 556 U. S. 163, 171 (2009)
See Stewart v. Martinez-Villareal, 523 U. S. 637, 641 (1998).
Id., at 641 (quoting Felker v. Turpin, 518 U. S. 651, 657 (1996)).
Burton v. Stewart, 549 U. S. 147, 152 (2007) (per curiam ).
cf. Hertz Corp. v. Friend, 559 U. S. 77, 83–84 (2010)
Castro, 540 U. S., at 381 (quoting Utah v. Evans, 536 U. S. 452, 463 (2002)).
see also post, at 52–53, 60–61 (opinion of Gorsuch, J.).
See Arbaugh v. Y & H Corp., 546 U. S. 500, 514–516 (2006);
See, e. g., Morrison v. National Australia Bank Ltd., 561 U. S. 247, 255 (2010)
